target.title: Hurghada Quad Bike Easy Ride
target.shortDescription: A beginner-friendly 30 km quad-bike ride through Hurghada’s Eastern Desert, with a Bedouin village visit, tea, camel ride and hotel transfers.
target.description:
Escape the resort and find your inner adventurer. Whether you’ve never touched a quad bike or you’re looking for a relaxing way to see the Desert, this “Easy Ride” is designed for you.

Why You’ll Love This Experience?

Most desert tours feel like a race. Our Easy Ride is different. It’s about the journey, the scenery, and the stories. Perfect for beginners, families, and those who want to soak in the majestic landscape of the Eastern Desert without the pressure of high-speed racing.

The Adventure Highlights:

* The Thrill of the Ride: Master the sands on your own quad bike. Our expert guides ensure you’re comfortable and confident before we head into the dunes.

* A Journey Through Time: Ride 30km into the heart of the mountains to discover a hidden Bedouin village.

* Authentic Hospitality: Sip on traditional Bedouin tea, share stories, and experience a lifestyle that hasn’t changed in centuries.

* The “Desert Ship”: Complete your Desert dream with a gentle camel ride across the golden sands—the ultimate photo opportunity.

What to Expect (Tour Itinerary)

1. Door-to-Desert Service

We’ll pick you up from your Hurghada hotel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. No stress, no navigation—just sit back and watch the city fade into the horizon.

2. Safety First, Fun Second

At our professional safari center, you’ll receive a safety briefing and a quick test drive. We specialize in beginners, so we take the time to make sure you feel like a pro before we set off.

3. Into the Mountains

Follow your guide on a 45-minute trek through dramatic mountain passes and open plains. The scenery is breathtaking, and the pace is steady—perfect for taking it all in.

4. The Bedouin Village

Step off your bike and into another world. In the village, you’ll enjoy:

* Freshly brewed Bedouin tea.

* A guided look into local traditions and culture.

* A peaceful camel ride to see the desert from a different perspective.

5. The Return Journey

As we head back to the base, enjoy one last look at the vast Egyptian wilderness before we drop you safely back at your hotel in time for your next meal.

target.title: Quad Bike Safari: Half-Day Trip to Sahara Park
target.shortDescription: A half-day quad-bike trip to Sahara Park with Bedouin tea and bread, a camel and spider-car ride, barbecue dinner and an oriental show.
target.description:
Take an adventure by Quad Bike Safari: Half-Day Trip to Sahara Park. On this tour, you will meet Bedouin people, taste Bedouin tea, enjoy a BBQ dinner & oriental show.

Quad Bike Safari: Half-Day Trip to Sahara Park – Tour Full Info.

Climb your Quad Bike and start your Half-Day trip to Sahara Park. The tour starts when you’re picked up at your hotel by an air-conditioned car taken to the Safari center, where you will have a quick test drive and get important instructions to begin your tour safely.

Get ready and invade the hills by your Quad Bike and enjoy the desert dramatic scenery. On the way, we will make a stop to see a mirage and climb a sandy dune with a beautiful view. After riding your Quad Bike for 45 minutes (30 km) approximately through the mountains, you will arrive at Sahara Park.

Here you can learn about Bedouin traditions and habits, taste Bedouin bread and Bedouin tea; have a camel ride, spider car ride (10 minutes), and visit our terrarium.

Finally, enjoy sunset views of Hurghada desert along with an open-buffet BBQ dinner with unlimited soft drinks and water followed by an entertaining show (Tanura, belly dancing, etc.…) before returning with your Quad Bike to where we started.

target.title: Makadi Bay: Quads by the Sea & Camel Ride
target.shortDescription: A two-hour quad-bike route through Makadi Bay’s desert and Red Sea coast, with Bedouin tea and a camel ride.
target.description:
Discover an unforgettable adventure in Makadi Bay with our Quads by the Sea & Camel Ride experience! Immerse yourself in the thrill of the desert as you unwind in a cozy Bedouin tent, sipping complimentary Egyptian tea. Enjoy a delightful camel ride around the camp, then rev up your excitement as you race through the desert on a quad bike. Explore the hidden beaches, enchanting caves, and vibrant coral reefs that Makadi Bay has to offer!

Makadi Bay: Quads by the Sea & Camel Ride – Tour Full Info

Kick off your adventure with a hassle-free pick-up from your hotel. Our cheerful driver will take you to Makadi Bay, where you’ll meet our skilled guides and get a quick safety briefing.

Get ready for an exciting 2-hour quad bike journey through the breathtaking desert scenery. Feel the thrill as you cruise over the golden sands and soak in the spectacular views of the expansive desert.

Then, head over to the coastline for a refreshing ride along the crystal-clear sea. Enjoy the striking contrast of the turquoise waters against the desert landscape and snap some fantastic photos.

After your thrilling ride, you’ll return to Makadi to unwind and share your stories. Finally, our driver will bring you back to your hotel, ensuring your adventure wraps up comfortably.
